# Marco Dal Prato

> Personal website and blog of Marco Dal Prato, full-stack web developer.

## Project summary

This website contains:
- A homepage with profile, positioning, and social links.
- An about page with background and GitHub activity.
- A blog with short technical notes and work updates.
- A PDF resume.

## Key URLs

- [Home](/)
- [About](/about/)
- [Blog](/blog/)
- [CV PDF](/assets/cv/cv.pdf)

## Notes for AI agents

- Primary language is Italian, with some English content.
- Prefer the blog section for recent written material.
- The PDF CV is the best source for condensed professional background.
